note: Known-answer vectors for docs/FORMAT.md section 18, version 2 of the keyring file. Root keys are given in hex as a key service or a passphrase would yield them; a tenant missing from tenant_roots is one whose root key cannot be obtained. A vector with `refused` is a file a reader must refuse as a whole. Regenerate with `go test ./internal/crypto/keys -run TestKeyringV2Vectors -update`.
